questions.explanation: `git fetch` downloads remote changes without changing your current branch or working files; it does not update your local branch.

options: `git fetch` plus merge, or plus rebase depending on config
questions.explanation: `git pull = git fetch + merge` or `git fetch + rebase`, depending on configuration; that is why it can create merge conflicts.

questions.prompt: What does `-u` mean in `git push -u origin feature/login`?
options: `--set-upstream`: remember the mapping between the local and remote branch
questions.explanation: `-u` is `--set-upstream`: Git remembers the remote branch, so later `git push` and `git pull` need no arguments.
